scenario.summary: Signed in: pastes a valid SKU with quantity 0 into the Add Multiple Items box and checks the '1 SKU couldn't be added' message.
steps: Open the webstore and sign in
Quick Order, Add Multiple Items; verify pad heading; Paste Multiple
Paste '<validSku>, <belowMinimumQuantity>'; click Add All to Quick List
evidence: Independent method (priority 65, no dependsOn): it opens the webstore itself and clears the quick list / cart at the end, so it declares its own needs.

validSku z-2460001 (quickOrderPage!C11): active SimpleProduct 'Black + Decker 6.5 in Corded Angle Grinder', OutOfStockOptions DontTrackInventory, MinimumQuantity 1 / MaximumQuantity 100 (tda rows). The Playwright profile (2026-11-01) saw storefrontProductIndex 0; bin/tda readiness (2026-11-05) reports that the record now qualifies for these needs. Inventory 25 per warehouse row (tda rows dbo.ZnodeInventory). Preferred, not required.

The SKU must be a valid sellable simple product so that only the zero quantity makes the row fail: same need as the approved Playwright entry 'pasting a zero quantity is rejected' (PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 1, maxPersonalizableAttributes 0, store}). belowMinimumQuantity 0 is config; the message is expected-output (count '1 SKU' fixed by the test).

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): this method signs in itself with loginPage.successfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/quickOrderRetailUserTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B190/C190). An account lease (useExisting) is held by the method that declares it and released when that method ends, so every signing-in method declares its own need user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: its username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting), as the Selenium pilot entries T01-T04. Username/password are credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its own sheet. The scanner recorded the credential values only on LoginWithAUserAccount, MaximumAndMinimumQuantityValidations and AddMultipleProductsToCart; on the other methods the same two cells (same location, kind and masking) are declared from the test source (every method calls successfullLogin with them).

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart entries and the Playwright quick-order entries.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); product facts come from bin/tda rows dbo.ZnodePimProduct (2026-11-05) and the approved Playwright quick-order entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
